item.content: In ledgerly, amounts must stay Decimal end-to-end with exactly two decimal places; convert inputs with `to_money`/`round_money` from `ledgerly.money` and never use float arithmetic. Convert rates or other numerics via `Decimal(str(x))` before multiplying a Decimal.
